steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to EspoCRM at http://127.0.0.1:8097/ using username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}; verify the app is signed in and report the visible result.
02-open: Open Opportunities and report the exact names of all opportunities whose name starts with 'Seed:'; do not edit any records.

03-create: Create an opportunity named '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' linked to the actual account 'Bench Account', with a description including '{{runid}}', stage Negotiation, amount 12500 in the default currency, close date 2026-12-31, and assigned to the actual user 'Bench Assignee'. Use suggestions or a select dialog to choose linked records, save, then verify the saved values and report the record ID visible in the opportunity URL.

04-create: On the saved opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity', create and verify a Stream post whose {{03-create.close_date_input_type}} includes exactly the runid '{{runid}}'. Then report the post {{03-create.close_date_input_type}} and confirm the opportunity is still the saved record.
